headline: ENERGY FUELS BETS $1.9B ON MINE-TO-MAGNET: ACQUIRES GERMAN VAC TO BUILD WESTERN RARE EARTH CHAIN (UUUU)
source_name: Investing News Network / Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU) agreed June 23 to acquire Vacuumschmelze GmbH (VAC) — a 100-year-old German advanced magnetics company with 400+ patents and a South Carolina permanent magnet facility scalable to 12,000 tpa — for $1.9 billion ($718M cash + 65.853M shares), creating the most integrated Western mine-to-magnet rare earth supply chain outside China. The deal, expected to close early 2027, plugs directly into Energy Fuels' existing NdPr oxide production at Utah's White Mesa Mill and closes the last gap in a fully independent Western supply chain from mine to finished magnet.

headline: REVIVAL GOLD EXTENDS JOSS TO 850m DEPTH — 14.9 g/t OVER 5.9m ADDS 240m (70%) TO BEARTRACK-ARNETT RESOURCE (TSXV:RVG)
snippet: Revival Gold Inc. (TSXV: RVG) reported June 25 that hole BT26-254D at the Joss area of its Beartrack-Arnett Project in Idaho returned 14.9 g/t gold over 5.9 metres at 861 metres downhole, extending the deposit's vertical dimension by 240 metres (70%) to 850 metres total — a resource expansion that feeds directly into the upcoming Beartrack-Arnett resource estimate update and a potential future underground mine economic study for one of the largest undeveloped gold deposits in the United States.

headline: TRAXXIN HITS 100.7 g/t — 476 g/t PEAK AS BOLD VENTURES OPENS NEW PARALLEL GOLD ZONE IN ONTARIO (TSXV:BOL)
snippet: Bold Ventures Inc. (TSXV: BOL) announced June 25 that hole TX-26-02 at the Traxxin Main Zone (130km WNW of Thunder Bay, Ontario) returned 100.7 g/t gold over 2.95 metres — the project's highest-grade drill result since the 2016 discovery — including 476 g/t over 0.6 metres, while also providing first evidence of a parallel shear zone east of the Main Zone that opens an entirely new lateral exploration corridor at a project where shallow high-grade vein mineralisation remains open in multiple directions.

headline: PCE PRINTS IN-LINE AT 4.1%; CORE RUNS 3.4% — GOLD HOLDS BELOW $4,000, SEPTEMBER HIKE ODDS UNCHANGED AT 68%
snippet: May PCE inflation came in at 4.1% year-over-year on June 25 — exactly in line with consensus — but core PCE YoY arrived at 3.4%, a tick above the 3.3% forecast, preventing the relief rally bulls needed: gold traded near $3,980 and silver near $57 with CME FedWatch holding September rate-hike probability at approximately 68%. The softer 0.32% core month-over-month print offered modest reassurance against re-acceleration but did not shift the Fed's hawkish posture or unwind the rate-hike premium driving gold's 28% correction from January's $5,589 all-time high.

headline: DLP RESOURCES EXPANDS ESPERANZA TO 5km x 2.5km — 7.8 g/t AU, MAIDEN DRILL STARTS AUGUST 2026 IN SOUTHERN PERU (TSXV:DLP)
source_name: Investing News Network / DLP Resources Inc. (TSXV:DLP)
snippet: DLP Resources Inc. (TSXV: DLP) announced June 25 surface rock samples up to 7.8 g/t gold and 27.7 g/t silver from its Esperanza copper-gold-molybdenum porphyry in southern Peru, with a drone-based magnetic survey expanding the exploration target to 5 km × 2.5 km — one of the largest undrilled copper-gold footprints in the region. A 3,000-metre maiden drill program is advancing through permitting with commencement planned for August 2026, targeting the interpreted copper-gold core of a large, structurally intact porphyry system.

headline: TRACTION URANIUM LAUNCHES AURORA AIRBORNE SURVEY — 17km ATHABASCA BASIN MARGIN STRIKE, DRILL PROGRAM FORMING (CSE:TRAC)
snippet: Traction Uranium Corp. (CSE: TRAC) announced June 25 that a 5,212-line-kilometre high-resolution radiometric and aeromagnetic survey has commenced at the Aurora Uranium Project in Saskatchewan — 16 km from Cameco's Key Lake mill, covering 18,744 hectares across 17 km of prospective basin margin strike. Results will drive target prioritisation for Traction's first-ever drill program at Aurora under its 80% earn-in option from Cosa Resources Corp. (TSXV:COSA), with the approximately 17-day survey expected to complete by mid-July.

headline: EAGLE PLAINS + XCITE VTEM CONFIRMS EM CONDUCTORS ON URANIUM DEPOSITS AT DON LAKE AND SMITTY — DRILL Q3/Q4 2026
source_name: Stockhouse / Eagle Plains Resources (TSXV:EPL) + Xcite Uranium (CSE:XRI)
snippet: Eagle Plains Resources (TSXV:EPL) and partner Xcite Uranium (CSE:XRI) released June 25 VTEM airborne survey results confirming a high electromagnetic conductivity feature directly coincident with Zone A, Zone B, and the Hawker Trench uranium deposits at Don Lake near Uranium City, Saskatchewan, plus an untested high-conductivity anomaly in the western Smitty claim block. Advanced interpretation by Condor Consulting will support Q3/Q4 2026 drill targeting in a Cold War-era camp with known near-surface uranium mineralisation and historic past-producing mines.

headline: GLEASON: FORT KNOX HOLDS GOLD "UNFIT FOR INTERNATIONAL TRANSACTIONS" — DE-DOLLARISATION ACCELERATES REGARDLESS
snippet: Money Metals Exchange CEO Stefan Gleason argued June 23 that gold's structural bull case is reinforced by three converging factors: U.S. gold reserves are impure and unfit for international settlement, federal debt interest costs exceeding $1 trillion annually make sustained tightening politically untenable, and the post-Ukraine asset freeze has permanently accelerated sovereign de-dollarisation regardless of short-term rate cycles. Gleason frames sub-$4,000 gold and $57 silver as a durable accumulation window for investors positioned for a broader monetary system transition.

headline: SILVER OPENS AT DEC '25 LOWS — $57.60 AS 67:1 GOLD-SILVER RATIO HITS WIDEST SINCE IRAN WAR PEAK
snippet: Silver opened June 25 at $57.60 — its lowest opening price since December 2025 — with the gold-silver ratio stretching to 67:1, the widest since the Iran conflict's January peak, as CME FedWatch held September rate-hike odds at 68% ahead of the morning PCE report. Silver's $57-range represents a 53% collapse from January's $121.62 all-time high, resetting futures positioning to a contrarian extreme that has historically preceded the largest percentage recoveries in any precious metals cycle.

headline: CHINA IMPORTS 790+ TONNES OF GOLD IN EARLY 2026 — STRUCTURAL DEMAND INTACT AS RATE-DRIVEN CORRECTION MASKS FUNDAMENTALS
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Gold SWOT analysis found China's gold imports reached 790+ tonnes in early 2026 — on pace for another record annual total — while silver's sixth consecutive structural supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces is unchanged by Fed rate signals, presenting a bifurcated market where the rate-driven paper correction is masking historically strong physical demand. The analysis argues the structural case at $4,000 gold is more intact than at January's $5,589 peak, and that the current positioning extreme mirrors the 2021 selloff that preceded a new all-time high.
